environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate task in isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW route). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumers connect exclusively through Interface VPC Endpoints with endpoint policies restricting principal to specific account IDs. The NLB has no public IP and the subnet route table contains only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. Security group on the Fargate ENI allows inbound TCP/8443 only from the VPC endpoint ENI security group (sg-0fe8a3b912cd4e567). DNS resolution for the service FQDN returns only private IPs within the VPC CIDR via Route53 private hosted zone. No public DNS record exists.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public record
